layouts.name: Loton Hillclimb
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Open climb follows the forward timed section of the independently named Loton Park Speed Hill Climb source way. The operator identifies the uphill course; the catalogue picture also shows the southern return loop, which is excluded from this timed draft. Separate endpoint nodes agree with timing gates. This independent timed section measures 1,303.5 m while the catalogue scalar 2,019 m describes a longer extent; no return-road detour or coordinate scaling is used to match that number. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1303.5 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
